hypotheses.mechanism: Remove free-form realization of hard clauses: deterministically render identity, authority, negation, quantities and commands; allow generative German only in explicitly soft slots.
hypotheses.counterprediction: quality cost dominates and no unique semantic coverage

hypotheses.mechanism: Semantic Parity Lattice: represent hard meaning as intersecting independent constraint projections rather than one translator judgment; candidate Clay must satisfy all observed projections, UNKNOWN is an erasure.
hypotheses.expected_gain: detect correlated translator faults without making checker a second mind

hypotheses.mechanism: Two implementation-diverse bounded translators/checkers must agree on hard fields; disagreement degrades to ambiguity.
hypotheses.counterprediction: known redundancy is sufficient and candidate has no novelty
hypotheses.falsifier: ordinary diverse pair achieves same fault detection

hypotheses.mechanism: Semantic hysteresis: consequential interpretations cannot flip hard fields across adjacent paraphrases/turn retries without an explicit new evidence witness; unstable boundary enters clarification state.
hypotheses.falsifier: deterministic baseline ties stability and fidelity
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: roundtrip contract is pointwise, not temporal

hypotheses.expected_gain: state-aware emotional German without semantic drift
hypotheses.counterprediction: field separation plus tests is equivalent
hypotheses.falsifier: ordinary structured style slot gives identical noninterference

hypotheses.mechanism: Semantic syndrome code: compute several independent low-dimensional hard-field syndromes; translation is accepted only if source-observed and destination-derived syndromes are compatible; UNKNOWN behaves as erasure, contradiction as detected error.
hypotheses.expected_gain: error detection with bounded checker complexity
hypotheses.counterprediction: syndromes are merely lossy parsing and either miss errors or reject too much
hypotheses.falsifier: full checker dominates detection/cost or syndrome collision produces consequential false PASS
hypotheses.minimum_test: large synthetic corpus with single/multi-field corruptions and common-mode translator bugs

hypotheses.mechanism: Proof-carrying translation: translator output is untrusted until a smaller checker validates a witness binding source constraints, destination typed fields and unsupported/ambiguous regions.
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: directive specifies tests but not per-message validated witness

hypotheses.mechanism: Metamorphic boundary adversary continuously derives meaning-preserving and meaning-flipping German mutations from each hard-field frame and checks expected Clay invariances/changes before release qualification.

hypotheses.falsifier: standard n-best representation matches all semantics/cost
